# Do you have to use Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, and when?

> Free UK Making Tax Digital for Income Tax checker: enter your gross self-employment and property income to see if you must join, from which date (April 2026, 2027 or 2028), and your quarterly and final declaration deadlines. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
